entities.summary: Boris Aleksandrovich Mayorov is a retired Russian ice hockey player who played in the Soviet Hockey League. He played for HC Spartak Moscow and was inducted into the Russian and Soviet Hockey Hall of Fame in 1963. Mayorov was inducted into the player category of the International Ice Hockey Federation Hall of Fame in 1999.
